Ensure the rounded chin immediately meets the raised broadened existing neckline with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Avoid separate yellow neck shafts, pointed V funnels, pinched collars, neck rolls, floating collars, clipping, or cream belly bibs. Preserve the CLOSED upright-collar tunic and actual fastening with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. All solid surfaces must remain opaque with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated and indistinct as observed.

Short dense DARK BLACK hair swept back with an uneven/receding frontal hairline, real dark eyebrow HAIR and thick dark UPPER-LIP MOUSTACHE, clean chin and stern closed mouth. Dark olive/near-black CLOSED upright-collar military tunic; retain small round gold collar-end buttons, small source-visible gold shoulder areas and subdued lower central gold fastening/decoration. No cap, spectacles, tie or beard. Fine insignia engraving is indistinct, do not invent it.
Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.

Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric.
